name: The Black Shield
summary: At Theramore's smithy, Captain Garran Vimes sends a shield to a smith who may know its maker.

sections.title: A Smith Who Can Say
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes knows little about the shield. So he sends you to Caz Twosprocket, one of the best blacksmiths around. Caz tends the forge in Theramore's smithy and may be able to tell you more.

sections.title: The Smith's Opinion
sections.body: Caz Twosprocket examines the iron and calls it an interesting piece. Caz says it is not their work, nor the work of any smith they know on this side of the water.

faq.q: Who sends you to examine the shield?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore sends you to a smith who may know more about the shield.

aliases: who is the blacksmith in theramore
faq.answer: Caz Twosprocket tends the forge in Theramore's smithy. Vimes counts Caz among the best blacksmiths around.

faq.q: What shield is shown to Caz?
aliases: what shield do i show caz
